description: This is a Java test class for testing external asset owner transfer cancellation in a financial application, specifically for the Fineract platform. It contains setup methods, test cases for cancelling transfers, creating transfers, and verifying transfer states and related journal entries.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnerTransferCancelTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing cancellation of external asset owner transfers within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: ExpectedExternalTransferData
classes.description: Data class representing expected properties of an external transfer, used for validation within tests.

classes.name: ExpectedJournalEntryData
classes.description: Data class representing expected journal entry details for validation within tests.

methods.name: successCancelSale
methods.description: Test case verifying successful cancellation of a sale transfer.

methods.name: saleAndBuybackOnTheSameDay
methods.description: Test case verifying sale and buyback transfers executed on the same day and their cancellation.

methods.name: createSaleTransfer
methods.description: Helper method to initiate a sale transfer for a given loan.

methods.name: createBuybackTransfer
methods.description: Helper method to initiate a buyback transfer for a given loan.

methods.name: addPenaltyForLoan
methods.description: Adds a penalty charge to a specific loan.

methods.name: setInitialBusinessDate
methods.description: Sets the initial business date for testing.

methods.name: cleanUpAndRestoreBusinessDate
methods.description: Restores the original business date after tests.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new client for testing purposes.

methods.name: createLoanForClient
methods.description: Creates and approves a loan for an existing client.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Creates a loan product with specified configurations.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplication
methods.description: Applies for a loan for a client and sets it up for testing.

methods.name: getAndValidateExternalAssetOwnerTransferByLoan
methods.description: Retrieves and validates external transfer data for a specific loan against expected data.

methods.name: getAndValidateThereIsNoActiveMapping
methods.description: Validates that there is no active external transfer mapping for a given loan or transfer external ID.

methods.name: validateResponse
methods.description: Validates the response of transfer initiation API calls.
